title: Bug 641489: Show Next/Previous Operation No. on routing lines when Type = Parallel
summary: Next Operation No. and Previous Operation No. fields on routing lines now automatically show when routing type is Parallel instead of remaining hardcoded invisible, eliminating the need for manual personalization.
key_points: Fields visibility now binds to routing type: shows for Parallel, hides for Serial
Visibility can be controlled via SetParallelFieldsVisible setter on subform
Parent routing cards trigger visibility updates in OnAfterGetRecord and Type field OnValidate
Workaround no longer needed for ISV apps that previously personalized these fields manually
UI tests added to verify automatic field visibility
